Focus on Alerts That Matter with the Offensive Security Engine™

  • Eliminate false positives and easily identify actionable alerts, saving teams hours of time spent validating findings.
  • Continuously simulate harmless attacks on cloud infrastructure to determine true vulnerabilities by providing “proof of exploitability” with Verified Exploit Paths™.
  • Stay on top of the latest exploits and CVEs and quickly determine if any of your cloud resources are affected by latest vulnerabilities.
See How

Safeguard AI Data & Infrastructure

  • Discover, classify, and protect data fueling AI workloads. Prevent high-risk data from use in AI training with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM).
  • Inventory your AI infrastructure, detect AI-native misconfigurations, and ensure compliance with AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM).
  • Proactively resolve potential issues with visualized attack paths for your AI workloads.
Learn More

Take the Headache Out of Compliance for Multi-Cloud Environments

  • Ensure that any misconfigured cloud asset—such as VMs, containers, or serverless functions—is identified and flagged using a CSPM with more than 2,000 built-in checks.
  • Get support for major cloud service providers, including AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, DigitalOcean, and Alibaba Cloud. Leverage a single-pane view for all your cloud security needs.
  • Get a real-time compliance score showing multiple standards, including NIST, MITRE, and CIS, with the cloud compliance dashboard.

Container and Kubernetes Security

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Scanning

FAQ

Which cloud platforms does Singularity Cloud Native Security support?

Singularity Cloud Native Security provides security across major cloud providers, including AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, Alibaba Cloud and Digital Ocean.

What types of assets does Singularity Cloud Native Security inventory?

Singularity Cloud Native Security monitors all cloud assets including VMs, containers, serverless databases, and others

How long does Singularity Cloud Native Security take to deploy?

Singularity Cloud Native Security connects to your account in less than 5 minutes and immediately starts protecting your cloud assets.

How often does the Offensive Security Engine™ scan for exploits?

The Offensive Security Engine™ automatically scans new resources as soon as they’re deployed in addition to weekly scans of all existing infrastructure alerts for evidence of exploitability.

How many types of secrets does Singularity Cloud Native Security scan for?

Singularity Cloud Native Security scans more than 750 secrets, including AWS and GCP authentication tokens, Stripe tokens, and more.

Which compliance frameworks does Singularity Cloud Native Security support?

Singularity Cloud Native Security currently supports 29 compliance frameworks, including CIS, SOC2, HIPAA, PCI DSS—and is frequently updated to support additional frameworks.

How much does Singularity Cloud Native Security cost?

Pricing for Singularity Cloud Native Security is based on the effective workloads being protected, and is calculated by aggregating individual resources across VMs, containers, serverless functions, and container image repositories.
